subject: English
passage: Fiona Sullivan, a pioneering figure in sustainable architecture in Singapore, made several innovations to the typical building ______ rooftop gardens so residents could grow food locally, water collection systems to reduce dependence on municipal supply, and solar panels positioned to maximize energy generation in tropical conditions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The sentence contains an independent clause stating that Sullivan made innovations, followed by a list of specific examples of those innovations. A colon is the appropriate punctuation to introduce an explanatory list after an independent clause. The colon signals that what follows will specify and elaborate on the general term 'innovations' mentioned in the main clause.
